text:
alex: Hey team — CloudNova legal asked us to lock down logo usage, colors, and the short quote for the co-authored case brief before we publish to the marketplace. I attached the draft PDF and the current hero artwork. Can marketing / legal confirm any issues?

maya: Thanks Alex — got the PDF. Quick Q: do we have permission for the CloudNova logo on the front page and the smaller partner lockup in the footer? Their guidelines usually require a 16px clearspace and no background crops.

sarah (CloudNova): Confirmed — you have permission to use the primary logo and lockup. Two asks from our side: (1) use the horizontal logo on the cover, not the stacked one, (2) keep their hex #0058D6 as the primary accent for any callouts.

zoe-marketing: Noted. Alex, can you drop the horizontal logo into the cover mock and export a new PDF? Also need an approved 1-sentence quote from CloudNova for the sidebar. Sarah, can you provide a short quote we can use that mentions performance and reliability?

tj: Also flagging engineering note: any technical callouts about our Dedicated offering should avoid specific throughput numbers unless we qualify the test environment. CloudNova's marketplace listing will copy parts of this brief so we should be careful.

alex: On it — I'll swap the asset and re-export. For the quote, Sarah suggested yesterday: "Redwood Inference cut our inference latency in half while cutting unit cost." Is that okay?

sarah (CloudNova): That wording is fine but legal asked to soften to "significantly reduced" instead of "cut in half" — they need a signoff from our side.

legal-bot: Reminder: any customer-facing performance claims require a reference test matrix and approval thread in legal-approvals. Please attach the test spreadsheet or change the phrasing to conditional.

zoe-marketing: We can change to: "Redwood Inference significantly reduced our inference latency while improving cost efficiency." That should pass legal. I'll prepare a marketplace-ready hero and the social assets once we get the logo PNG and final quote. Target publish: next Tue if legal signs off by EOD Fri.

maya: Quick branding nit: CloudNova prefers PNG with sRGB profile and no alpha for the cover. Also they asked we don't place their logo over photo gradients. We should use the blue strip for contrast instead.

alex: Uploaded new PDF `1778005555-coauth-brief-v2.pdf` with horizontal logo and blue strip. Also included a masked footer lockup PNG. Link: https://files.redwood/brand/1778005555-v2.pdf

zoe-marketing: Previewed — looks good. I'll queue an internal review thread for creative and ops. Can someone @legal-ops to review the quote and the performance note?

sarah (CloudNova): I'll ping our legal lead and circle back. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

tj: One more ops note — for the marketplace listing we should avoid platform-specific screenshots unless both sides sign off. Recommend using abstract architecture diagram only.

alex: Agree. I'll remove the dedicated-benchmark screenshot from page 6 and replace with an architecture tile. Final ask: if legal gives the green light, can we get a short partner quote image (logo + quote) for the marketplace tile? Zoe, can you make that asset?

zoe-marketing: Yes — I'll produce a 1200x628 PNG, plus a small square for social. Will attach to the publishing ticket once legal confirms.

legal-bot: Note recorded. Moving to #legal-approvals with reference to this thread (1778005555).

alex: Thanks everyone — tracking actions: alex -> export final PDFs, zoe -> produce marketplace/social PNGs, sarah -> legal signoff, tj -> remove benchmark screenshot, maya -> confirm color hex and PNG specs. Will update the publishing ticket when all are done. :thumbsup:
